events.summary: Bejahn was elected to call in the imperial champion Tetsuo Umezawa when the cat-dragon Wasitora attacked Sekana.
events.quote: Bejahn was elected on behalf of Sekana village to call in the imperial champion, Tetsuo Umezawa , when the cat-dragon Wasitora attacked the village, demanding fish.

events.summary: Xira Arien hurt Bejahn for being in the wrong place at the wrong time.
events.quote: She was hurt by Xira Arien for being at the wrong place at the wrong time

events.summary: Bejahn witnessed Orai Daiyeta's kentsu squad wiped out by the nekoru and her kittens.
events.quote: witnessed Orai Daiyeta 's kentsu squad being wiped out by the nekoru and her five kittens
